AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ticket_type tt WHERE tt.show_id = s.id AND tt.status = 1 AND tt.sale_end_time >= NOW() )
(SELECT MIN(tt.price) FROM tb_ticket_type tt INNER JOIN tb_show sx ON sx.id = tt.show_id WHERE sx.performance_id = p.id AND tt.status = 1)
AND p.status = 2 AND s.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND s.start_time > NOW()

CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS showId, CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS performanceId, COALESCE(p.title, s.title) AS title, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p.artist_name, s.artist, '')), '') AS artist, COALESCE(p.poster, s.image) AS cover, p.poster_tag AS posterTag, DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS showTime, DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startTime, v.name AS venueName, v.city AS city, AS minPrice, s.status AS status, COALESCE(p.is_real_name, s.is_real_name, 1) AS isRealName, p.type AS type, IFNULL(p.want_count, 0) AS wantCount, '售票中' AS statusText, CASE WHEN p.poster_tag IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.poster_tag) != '' THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS cardType
